source: Oliveboard CBE 'challenge module' response-sheet export of the actual SSC CGL 2025 Tier I screen - header 'Exam Level: SSC CGL Tier 1 | Test Date: 12 Sep 2025 | Test Time and Shift: 12:30 PM (Shift-2)' with per-question status legend 'Correct Option selected / Wrong Option selected / Correct Option / Not Answered' and candidate undertaking: https://download.oliveboard.in/pdf/ssc-cgl-12th-sep-shift-2.pdf (accessed 2026-08-24; linked from Oliveboard's SSC CGL Tier 1 PYP page https://www.oliveboard.in/blog/ssc-cgl-tier-1-pyps/). IMPORTANT export caveat (verbatim from the PDF): 'in the challenge module the sequence of the questions and the options may be different from how it appeared during the examination ... the answer key selected by the candidates during the examination will exactly be reflected in the challenge module.' - i.e. question/option ORDER in this export may not match the live CBE screen order, though the candidate's selections are preserved. One question (the implicit-assumptions statement, recorded here as question_number 8) appears unnumbered in the export between Q.No 7 and Q.No 9.

notes: PARTIAL-CONTENT FILE - READ FIRST: this is a genuine SSC CBE response-sheet export ('challenge module' save) for the exact date+shift (header Test Date 12 Sep 2025, 12:30 PM Shift-2), but the source PDF is longer than the 30-page parse limit available in this environment: only PART-A (General Intelligence and Reasoning, Q1-25), PART-B (General Awareness, Q26-50) and the first three PART-C (Quantitative Aptitude) questions (Q51-53, Q53 stem only) are in the parsed layer; Q54-75 (Quant) and Q76-100 (English) are ABSENT from the parsed layer and are marked [NOT RECOVERABLE] - they have NOT been invented, completed or paraphrased. Within the recovered range: Q12, Q13, Q19, Q27, Q29, Q30, Q31, Q32, Q44, Q48 have empty question bodies in the parsed layer; Q28, Q47, Q53 have missing options; Q22 has only 3 options; Q8 (unnumbered in the export) is missing its assumptions list. SECTIONS/NUMBERING: this export numbers questions globally 1-100 in the order PART-A GI&R (1-25), PART-B General Awareness (26-50), PART-C Quantitative Aptitude (51-75), PART-D English (76-100) - the section labels and Q.No are from the export itself. ORDER CAVEAT (quoted above): the challenge-module export may reorder questions and options relative to the live exam screen; the candidate's answer selections are preserved. This file therefore does NOT guarantee the live screen's question/option order. BILINGUAL SOURCE: every question in the source is bilingual (English + Hindi); only the English layer was transcribed here (the Hindi layers are largely garbled in the parsed text and are noted verbatim only where they contain otherwise-recoverable content, e.g. the Hindi fragment at Q49). SSC QUESTION IDs: not present in this export class; question_id is null throughout. CANDIDATE RESPONSES: only the 'Not Answered' status was recoverable as text (Q8, Q19, Q20, Q27, Q28, Q30, Q32, Q33, Q43, Q44); answered-question status markers ('Correct Option selected'/'Wrong Option selected') are rendered as graphics and were NOT recovered, so no candidate choice is recorded. ANSWERS: the export's legend implies per-question correct/incorrect marking, but the actual correct-option identity is not present in the recovered text layer for any question, and the official CGL 2025 tentative answer key (SSC, October 2025) is downloadable only by logged-in candidates; no machine-accessible official key was found in this environment - so every correct_answer here is null and answer_source null. Do not infer answers from the export legend or from AI reasoning.
